register.title: PingYou Ltd's PR 574 certificate refinements at 4c319c2
register.headline: Tighter rational certificates of others' packings at 85 counts, cutting padding by 1e-61 to 1e-19 and relaying newer packings
register.source_checks: The author reports that a standard-library exact checker of its own, by separating axes and by rational polygon clipping, accepts all 147 v2 certificates and their pre-batch comparators with 2,678,449 unordered pairs per checker, rejects duplicate-square and outside-container controls, and that this repository's packing-witness verify and check_rational_witness_independent, unchanged at e96e9ea, accept every native corners Witness/v2 of the v2 release; and, for the supplement, that its checker isolates each declared real root by rational Sturm counts and accepts the 60 exact certificates with 917,302 pairs, and that the native verifier accepts their native witnesses. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit PingYou Ltd (https://github.com/BuddenPing/square-packing-certificates) with the certificate refinements, as the submission asks: smaller padding, an exact common-centre crop or an exact re-solve of each packing's own contacts. The packings are others': the submission names per count the original construction authors and preceding refiners it starts from, among them Erich Friedman's and David Ellsworth's catalogue constructions as Evan Daniel's exact certificates and regularized lists state them, Ryan Xu, Robert Barnett, Francisco Couzo, Daniil Ostashev, Nate Chaoweeraprasit (SQUISH), Siddharth Gupta, Kevin Fang and Mishapolk, and it says that padding reduction does not transfer authorship of an existing packing. Each count is a regularization of the packing whose certificate it tightens. The source makes no statement about AI assistance in this pull request; for its #503 and #504 certificates the author said on 12 October 2026 that they were AI assisted by 'PY', an unreleased agentic AI offering by PingYou Ltd.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay; then, at each count, record the side as a regularization of the packing whose certificate it tightens, credited to that packing's finder, and decide adoption against every pending report: the margins below the case ceilings are 1e-61 to 1e-19 except where the certificate relays a newer packing of another open report. The algebraic certificates of the same pull request (58 counts and the N153/N302 supplement) need an exact algebraic replay of their own, priced in the packet. Final exact-head CI remains required.
